years.blurb_en: Chitinase-secreting bacteria that stay in the banana root zone, against Fusarium wilt TR4.
years.blurb_zh: 會分泌幾丁質酶、並被限制在香蕉根圈的工程菌，對抗香蕉黃葉病 TR4。

years.blurb_en: A probiotic biofilm with a coral-localisation kill switch, to protect reef-building corals from disease.
years.blurb_zh: 搭配珊瑚定位自殺開關的益生菌生物膜，保護造礁珊瑚免於疾病。

years.blurb_en: Cheaper, safer larvicides that pair Bt toxins with a mosquito-specific scorpion toxin, to help end dengue by 2030.
years.blurb_zh: 結合 Bt 毒素與專一作用於蚊子的蠍毒素，做出更便宜、更安全的殺幼蟲劑，助力 2030 年終結登革熱。

years.blurb_en: An engineered TfCut2 enzyme that breaks down PET in polyester–cotton blends, so mixed textiles can be recycled.
years.blurb_zh: 以改造的 TfCut2 酵素分解聚酯棉混紡中的 PET，讓混紡衣物得以回收。

years.blurb_en: A stress-responsive optogenetic bioreactor that makes crop protectants on the farm, for smallholder growers.
years.blurb_zh: 受逆境訊號驅動的光遺傳生物反應器，讓小農在農場現地生產作物保護劑。
